Players Committee card image of [[Allegiant General Pryde (Errata)]] (PC-E1 image; errata mark “E”), printing: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Hux is forfeit -3. While with a Resistance character, adds one battle destiny. While Emperor on table, attrition against opponent here is +1 for each First Order character here (limit +3).” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/2f0f28b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual12-Dark/hires/allegiantgeneralpryde.png Images-HT/starwars/Virtual12-Dark/hires/allegiantgeneralpryde.png] as of commit 2f0f28b “2021 March Errata” (18 March 2021).
